title: XYZ Forge — Releases, Roadmap, Work Events, and Derived Projections
sources: ROUTER.md — RELEASES DB and roadmap_items are the releases-mode source of truth
RELEASES-DB-FAQS.md — runtime DB / generation-stamped SQL merge contract
utils/py/releases_app.py — perform_write, roadmap list/render, work_events, adopted-view refresh
utils/py/work_connectors/ + board_sync.py — bounded post-commit connector projection

nodes.label: releases_app.py verbs
nodes.tech: release · manifest · roadmap · jog · work · check
nodes.description: Only supported business-write surface. roadmap list/list --json/render are current read paths; legacy gen/drift commands refuse.

nodes.label: WriterLock + intent journal + receipts
nodes.description: Journal before commit; BEGIN IMMEDIATE; mutate; generation + op_receipt/work_event; commit; stage dump; atomic rename; clear journal; then best-effort projections.

nodes.label: releases.db
nodes.description: Runtime authority for releases, manifests, roadmap_items, Jog, receipts, append-only work_events and device-local connector cursors.

nodes.label: releases.sql
nodes.description: Git merge surface and rebuild input. Ordinary writes refresh it atomically from the committed DB transaction; merge conflicts are resolved here.

nodes.label: Ledger merge resolver
nodes.description: Validates the resolved dump and generation, rebuilds releases.db with backup, checks it, regenerates only adopted views and stages the result.

nodes.label: Roadmap query surface
nodes.description: Direct human/machine queries from roadmap_items. render writes only to stdout or an explicit output; there is no committed ROADMAP dashboard.

nodes.label: HQ, planner, PDDA, release-cycle, Flightdeck
nodes.description: Aggregated current readers: HQ rollup, Marathon planning, doc checks, release-cycle/timeline analysis, board sync and passive established-work views.

nodes.label: Append-only work_events
nodes.description: Lifecycle projection provenance emitted inside the same ledger transaction as its owning operation. UPDATE and DELETE are forbidden by triggers.

nodes.label: Bounded work connectors
nodes.description: After the durable ledger commit, configured connectors consume bounded event batches under one deadline. Failures never change the host verb's result; parent persists cursor advances.

nodes.label: GitHub Kanban projection
nodes.description: First shipped external work-state connector. It projects events to configured board fields without becoming authoritative for lifecycle state.

nodes.label: Root view adopted by presence?
nodes.description: A generator refreshes a root view only when that file already exists. Deleting a view retires it across every supported writer/reconciler.

nodes.label: Timeline exporter
nodes.description: Reads releases.db and emits optional release preview and HTML leaderboard projections.

nodes.label: Markdown leaderboard generator
nodes.description: Renders the ranked Markdown view from exporter JSON when LEADERBOARD.md is adopted.

nodes.label: RELEASES-PREVIEW.html
nodes.description: Presence-gated HTML release timeline; absent is a valid unadopted state.

nodes.label: LEADERBOARD.html
nodes.description: Presence-gated HTML ranking view; absent is a valid unadopted state.

nodes.label: LEADERBOARD.md
nodes.description: Presence-gated Markdown ranking view. Generated from releases.db and never hand-edited.

nodes.label: Pages site build
nodes.description: At deployment, consumes roadmap list --json and refuses empty or malformed data before writing the public roadmap page.

nodes.label: PAGES/roadmap.html
nodes.description: Public site projection rebuilt from the committed ledger during Pages deployment. It is separate from the root-view presence gate.

nodes.label: Hosted wave reconciliation workflow
nodes.description: Triggers reconciliation after a PR merges to development and on recovery schedules or manual dispatch.

nodes.label: wave_reconcile.py
nodes.description: Snapshots mutable artifacts, reconciles issue/doc/roadmap state, runs ledger checks and presence-gated generators, then prepares declared outputs.

nodes.label: Declared-artifact publisher
nodes.description: Commits and pushes only the allowlisted ledger, view and PROJECT artifacts back to development.

nodes.label: origin/development
nodes.description: Target of the hosted reconciliation commit and source branch for subsequent governed work.

nodes.label: Local pre-push guard
nodes.description: Classifies the outgoing range and routes a bounded local gate. This is a guard, not hosted attestation, and no longer checks a roadmap dashboard artifact.

nodes.label: Routed releases verification
nodes.description: Ledger, merge resolver and leaderboard paths select the releases subsystem suites; unknown classification fails closed to the full tier.

nodes.label: Hosted CI boundaries
nodes.tech: macOS main promotion · advisory Ubuntu development canary
nodes.description: Exact-commit macOS evidence qualifies promotion on main. The Ubuntu development job reports portability drift and is continue-on-error.

legend_note: ROADMAP-DASHBOARD.md, utils/roadmap-dashboard.sh and dashboard-staleness-guard.sh are deliberately absent: GH-567 retired them. Direct roadmap queries and deploy-time Pages generation replaced that committed artifact. Root release/leaderboard views remain optional by presence.
